cacheHint.note: cache by the JCS-canonical policy_parameters hash only; never by wall-clock or session

description: Composes a session receipt (build_session_receipt logic), an optional §27.6 HA evidence bundle (ha_bundle_export logic, included only when ha_records is supplied and non-empty), and a disclosure manifest (build_disclosure_manifest logic) from one array of already-produced artifacts, all keyed to the same input hashes -- replacing what today takes 4-6 separate tool calls with hand-carried hashes. Calls the same in-process functions those standalone tools use; if any one section fails to build, the whole call fails isError:true with that section's own message -- no partial pack. Optionally carries a run_chain decision_trail (per-step reason codes: gate rule id, escalation rule id, input_required cause) as pack-level metadata so an auditor-facing pack answers "why did each step happen" without a second round-trip.

artifacts.description: Already-produced artifacts this pack documents, in call order.

execution_hash.description: sha256:... -- the OCG artifact hash this entry documents.

output_payload.description: Present when caller has the full artifact, not just its hash.

tool_id.description: The tool_id that produced this artifact, if known.

decision_trail.description: Per-step decision reason trail from the run_chain result (pass its decision_trail — response field or composite_output.decision_trail). Carried verbatim into the pack as pack-level metadata, outside every section hash; omitted entirely when not supplied. See DECISIONTRAIL-1.

decided_by.description: step_id of the decision that routed control past this step.

gate_rule_id.description: <step_id>#r<index> or <step_id>#default — the gate rule that fired or bypassed this step. Recomputable from the hash-bound decisions[].

input_required_cause.description: The kernel error that made this step input_required.

next.description: Routing target of the gate decision (a step id, or the terminal "end"/"escalate").

order.description: 1-based step order, mirroring the producing run_chain result.

reason_code.description: Closed enum: ran | gate_routed | skipped_by_gate | skipped_by_escalation | input_required | unknown_node | gpu_browser_only | no_kernel_browser_only.

status.description: Per-step status from the run_chain result.

framing.description: Optional framing context for the session receipt's PTG-01 regulator prompt.

ha_records.description: §27 human_accountability_records -- omit entirely for no HA section.

kernel_version.description: Version tag of the kernel that produced verification_result.

policy_version.description: Version tag of the policy the kernel was evaluated against.

sd_jwt.description: When true, also return an SD-JWT export of the HA bundle (mirrors ha_bundle_export, default false; no-op when ha_records is absent).

session_id.description: Session identifier to embed in the receipt, if the caller tracks one.

subject_hash.description: The sha256: subject hash the pack documents (defaults to artifacts[0].execution_hash if omitted).

submission_receipt.description: Populate ONLY after a real transmission -- never fabricate (same rule as ha_bundle_export).

title: Assemble a complete evidence pack in one call
